audience: small businesses and call centres that run their phone lines on Telzio

useCases.title: Review missed and recent calls
useCases.text: List the call log, newest first. Open one call for its legs, price, hang-up causes and event timeline.

useCases.title: Check queues and agents right now
useCases.text: List the calls in progress and the call queues. Open one queue to see its agents, their status and the callers waiting.

useCases.title: Check users, groups and numbers
useCases.text: List the users with their extensions, the user groups and the phone numbers on the account.

useCases.title: Hang up or transfer a live call
useCases.text: Hang up a live call, or transfer it to a user, extension or external number. A hang-up ends the call for everyone on it.

useCases.title: Send a direct SMS from a Telzio number
useCases.text: Send one SMS to one recipient. The tool is for the account's own direct messages, not bulk or unsolicited sends.
